task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

calls.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task says 'Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off' — the siren rings until the agent toggles the switch, so the task demands a Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled), not ChainResponse. The siren cannot be silenced on the very next step in general (the agent may not be at the switch), and the task does not say 'next step'. Also the compiled machine misreads the semantics: ChainResponse fails when a step after siren_ringing has neither event, but the transition (u1, !siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u2 rejects exactly the steps when the siren has already stopped — including the very act of silencing it without toggling on that same... Replace the ChainResponse clause with a hard Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled): every ringing episode must end in switch_toggled on that step or later.
